newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends at new low on import demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends at new low on import demand.

text.p: Late import covering pushed the Sri Lankan rupee to a new closing low of 57.11 to the dollar on Friday after opening at 57.08, dealers said.
The previous closing low was 57.10 set on Wednesday.
"Import covering which came near the end was the main reason for the dollar gaining," said a Hatton National Bank dealer.
Dealers said the rupee stayed in a tight 57.05-57.11 range throughout the day.
The dolalr-rupee exchange rate which hovered around the Central Bank's selling rate this week would seek direction from the authorities again next week, they said.
The Central Bank on Friday fixed its buying and selling rates at 55.9969 and 57.1281, pushing the dollar up by one local cent.
"In the absence of hectic overseas movement, the market will seek direction from the Centrl Bank," said the Hatton National dealer.
The overnight call money rate closed at its opening level of 16 percent.
